D.t: Danny Minton trails by 9.2 and wins 7% of simulations. Closing it takes about 12,303 voters switching sides, or 24,606 more net votes from new turnout.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between R +16.8 and R +1.5. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
